messages:
tom_travel: Hey finance — just saw a corpcard charge for EventStaging for the KOL Summit booth crate. Charge is $1,420.24 on card ending *4321. They sent only a payment confirmation PDF, no tax ID or line-item invoice. Can we expense this?
emma_marketing: We need that crate onsite Tue AM. Vendor is insisting they only provide a proforma until funds clear.
marc_finance: Hi Tom — for accounting we require an itemized invoice with vendor tax ID (or VAT number) to process for VAT reclaim. Also note our PO policy: spends >$1,000 should have a PO. How urgent is the vendor payment?
tom_travel: Payment already went through on corpcard to avoid delivery hold. Urgent — staging said they won't release crates otherwise. I replied asking for a proper invoice but they replied we'll get a signed invoice after delivery.
sam_ops: I can get the bill of lading (BOL) and a signed proof-of-delivery from the driver when it arrives. Will that help?
marc_finance: BOL + signed POD helps substantiate the business purpose but doesn't replace a vendor invoice with tax ID for reclaiming VAT. We have two paths: 1) request procurement to approve a retroactive PO and accept vendor-signed invoice later, or 2) accept the charge now with manager approval and treat VAT as non-recoverable (charged to budget). Which do you want?
emma_marketing: If procurement can do a retro PO quickly that'd be ideal, otherwise I approve charging marketing budget for the VAT. This is mission-critical for the summit. :white_check_mark:
tom_travel: I'll upload whatever we get — BOL, payment confirmation (payment_confirmation_191999.pdf) and any signed invoice once it arrives. Also vendor email thread attached.
expensify-bot: New expense created: EXP-2026-0912 for $1,420.24, status: awaiting receipts.
marc_finance: OK — Tom, please add the BOL and payment confirmation to the expense report and paste the vendor email here. I'll ping procurement for a retro PO and flag this as time-sensitive. If procurement denies retro PO, we'll process it with manager approval and mark VAT as non-recoverable.
tom_travel: Done — uploaded files to Confluence at /events/kolsummit/receipts and linked in the expense. Vendor thread pasted below. Thanks all.
marc_finance: Got it. I'll follow up with procurement and update this thread. :thumbsup:
